//: Capability manifest for footer/1 (the .pc-layout__footer shell container) — keen-pure-admin. See section.map.json / card.map.json for the model. footer/1 renders <footer class="pc-layout__footer {class}"> with three optional section slots (start / center / end_) each → pc-footer__start/__center/__end; a section div is OMITTED when its slot is empty AND no config fallback fires. keen's end slot is named `end_` (Elixir reserves `end`). No endVertical / pc-footer__end--vertical counterpart. No required attrs/slots. Shared SSR features: the three section slots + the root class passthrough.
